_about: AFFALTER GT BLACK (the model's cabin, untextured): its cluster (one flat face behind the two round openings of its binnacle) and its centre screen are blank and share the interior's material, so each gets a board of its own, placed by measure (rays forward from section views; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): two round dials on the cluster (the speed, the revs to the 7,200 limiter), the centre screen's pages.
